changes: Calendar paging uses the SDK ScrollTrack profile, row-distance calculations and interruption sampling. Weekday headings remain fixed.
Picker template Arrange temporarily applies its slot constraints and restores them before the next Measure; field advances receive a physical-pixel ceiling.
Sample outputs use the existing bounded options column and readable values so selection does not change the preview width.
Keyboard focus and pending popup Escape process before the next render frame; visible out-of-scope date selection preserves the displayed month.
An initial CalendarDatePicker selection synchronizes without dismissing the popup.
Rust skips zero-sized Canvas presentation and floating backdrop sampling while preserving layout/events on hidden-host frames.
versionScope: The full Chromium/WebKit native static matrix and interaction suite use frozen validatedWasmSha256. A concurrent chat rebuilt the shared 5173 runtime afterward; all six reported regressions were rerun against liveRegressionWasmSha256 with identical before/after build stamps and a matching HTTP-served WASM hash. Full static-matrix results do not certify that later shared binary.
zeroSurfaceRegression: Canvas2D CalendarDatePicker popup is framed at 0x0 and restored without browser pageerror; covered in both Chromium and WebKit on validatedWasmSha256.
